justification: Both are upright stelae bearing low-relief scenes of standing human figures confronting one another with raised/extended arms, tall headgear, and small sign-like marks filling the upper field, with the scene divided into stacked zones. However, the specific forms differ: A shows a single dominant elaborately costumed figure with dense ornamental plumes and blocky glyph panels, while B shows multiple slimmer figures in two clear registers with an offering table and gesture-based interaction, so the correspondence stays at the level of a shared genre rather than a shared scene.
